bugsink.runs: /usr/lib/bugsink/bin/python -c 'import bugsink; from django.core.management import execute_from_command_line; assert callable(execute_from_command_line)'

n8n.runs:
node /usr/lib/n8n/node_modules/n8n/bin/n8n --version | grep -F '${{package.version}}'
cd /usr/lib/n8n
node --no-node-snapshot -e 'const sqlite=require("sqlite3"); const db=new sqlite.Database(":memory:"); db.get("select 42 as value",(err,row)=>{if(err||row.value!==42) process.exit(1); db.close();}); const ivm=require("isolated-vm"); const isolate=new ivm.Isolate({memoryLimit:16}); isolate.dispose();'

onnx.runs: for case in providers inference shape input; do python3.15 onnx-check.py "$case"; done

onnx-minilm.runs: python3.15 -c 'import json,pathlib; root=pathlib.Path("/usr/share/onnx/minilm-l6-v2/onnx"); assert (root/"model.onnx").stat().st_size > 1000000; assert (root/"vocab.txt").stat().st_size > 1000; [json.loads((root/name).read_text()) for name in ["config.json","tokenizer.json","tokenizer_config.json","special_tokens_map.json"]]'
